description_en: Queries the tags of a specified SQL statement by calling the GetQueryOptimizeTag operation
description_zh: 调用GetQueryOptimizeTag接口，获取指定SQL的标签
kebab_example: aliyun das get-query-optimize-tag --engine MySQL --sql-id 29d9fef63e347d39c3436658a5fe0000 --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetQueryOptimizeTag

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL: RDS MySQL
PolarDBMySQL: PolarDB for MySQL
PostgreSQL: RDS PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

MySQL：RDS MySQL
PolarDBMySQL：PolarDB MySQL版
PostgreSQL：RDS PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The SQL template ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405261.html operation to query the SQL template ID
parameters.help_zh:
SQL模板ID。
您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405261.html接口查询SQL模板ID
parameters.name: sql_id

Comments.example: Slow SQL from offline synchronization. No optimization needed.

Tags.description_en: The SQL tags. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,)
Tags.description_zh: SQL标签，多个标签间使用英文逗号（,）分隔

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
